content.text: You’ve spent months producing beats, mixing tracks, mastering your sound. Your music is ready. But when you try to sell it online, the payment processors reject you. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-10|stripe]] isn’t available in Kenya. PayPal flags your account. Conventional platforms lock you out. This isn’t a failure of effort—it’s a failure of infrastructure. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer architecture you own, control, and deploy. No platforms. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. This post breaks down how to sell music online using Bitcoin, automated file delivery, and open tools. By the end, you’ll understand the components, the logic, and the deployment steps to build a system that works anywhere—even where legacy payment systems fail.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is a self-hosted [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-broken-here-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]] commerce stack designed for creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store. The core components include hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and payment processing (NOWPayments for Bitcoin and 300+ cryptocurrencies). The system automates the entire transaction flow: from payment verification to instant product delivery. You own the infrastructure. No third-party platform controls your business. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-13|Financial Sovereignty]] isolation are realities. It’s built for creators who need sovereignty, not workarounds.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the transaction flow: A buyer selects your music and pays in Bitcoin via NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain, and a webhook triggers the backend logic. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script checks the payment status, retrieves the file from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and sends a secure download link to the buyer’s email. The order details are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets for your records. The system is stateless—no buyer accounts, no KYC, no platform lock-in. Bitcoin is used because it’s borderless, permissionless, and works anywhere. Transaction fees are under $0.10 on networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. The architecture is modular: swap components as needed. For example, use GitHub Pages for hosting if Cloudflare Pages is blocked in your region. The logic remains the same.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other regions where legacy payment systems fail. If you sell music, ebooks, courses, or software and cannot use Stripe or PayPal, this infrastructure is for you. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their business from platforms that can shut them down at any time. The system is designed for technical proficiency—you’ll deploy code, configure APIs, and manage your stack. But you don’t need to be a developer. The Complete Builder Kit provides blueprints, templates, and step-by-step guides. The goal is infrastructure sovereignty: you own the tools, the data, and the process. This isn’t a shortcut—it’s a foundation. If you’re willing to invest time and $197 in the Complete Builder Kit, you’ll own a commerce stack that works anywhere, forever.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platforms, no gatekeepers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront. Both are free and globally accessible. 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle payment verification, file retrieval, and email delivery. Workers are faster but require JavaScript knowledge. Apps Script is easier for beginners. 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase (a free Postgres database) or Google Sheets log transaction details. Supabase scales better, but Sheets is simpler. 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store your music files. R2 is more reliable for high traffic. 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments handles Bitcoin and 300+ cryptocurrencies. It charges a 0.5% fee, with no KYC or buyer accounts required. 6. **Email Delivery**: SMTP services like SendGrid or Gmail send download links. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for deliverability. Each component is replaceable. The system works because they communicate via APIs and webhooks—no hard dependencies.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your requirements. Do you need high scalability? Use Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. Prefer simplicity? Choose Google Apps Script and Sheets. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for blueprints, templates, and deployment guides. Follow the step-by-step instructions to set up hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. Test the system end-to-end before going live. Load your music files, simulate a purchase, and verify the delivery flow. Once deployed, you own the stack. No monthly fees. No platform risk. The kit includes a scaling playbook to handle growth. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Your music deserves infrastructure that works on your terms, not a platform’s.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell music online using Bitcoin without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a self-hosted commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. The system automates payment verification and instant file delivery. You own the infrastructure, ensuring sovereignty and reliability.
Bitcoin enables borderless payments with under $0.10 transaction fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy this architecture today, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints, templates, and guides. It includes step-by-step instructions for hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. The kit is designed for creators who want to own their commerce infrastructure, not rent it. Purchase at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and start building a system that works anywhere, forever.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload music files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. 6. Test the payment-to-delivery flow end-to-end. 7. Deploy your storefront and start selling. 8. Monitor transactions in your order storage system. 9. Scale components as your business grows. 10. Own your infrastructure—no platform dependencies.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not a developer?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes templates and guides for non-developers. You’ll need basic technical proficiency to follow instructions, but no coding experience is required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How are transaction fees calculated?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on each transaction. Network fees (e.g., Bitcoin or Solana) are under $0.10 per transaction, depending on the blockchain.
Can I switch components later?
Yes, the architecture is modular. For example, you can switch from Google Apps Script to Cloudflare Workers as your traffic grows.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your stack remains operational. NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform. If it fails, replace it with another crypto payment gateway without disrupting your system.
